nonblocking_findings.description: The sentence that substantiates the 0.2.4 publication claim links the receipt as https://github.com/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs/blob/56a88d25f72951b8569193f6252efefae7053ea3/docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json, but that commit cannot contain the receipt. docs/checks/phase-28-remote-ci-run-31-observation-07.json:2 binds run 31 to 56a88d25 with its first status at 16:07:07Z and all 49 contexts terminal by 17:40:42Z (lines 2640-2669), while docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json:7 records publishedAt 2026-10-22T17:49:15Z and checkedAt 17:49:18Z, so the file was created after 56a88d25 was already pushed. docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md:48-50 confirms the merged receipt was copied from governance commit 612864994, whose history is explicitly not integrated into the mirror, and docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/remote-branches-before-deployment.json:15-27 pins both remotes' refs/heads/main at 56a88d25. The published page will therefore serve a 404 for its only publication evidence link, and the recorded build cannot catch it because Docusaurus does not validate external URLs. The authoritative source wording at docs/STABILITY.md:3-5 deliberately uses a bare 'checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json' reference instead of a permalink.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Replace the permalink on docs-site/docs/developer/stability.md:6 with a reference that resolves: either cite the retained receipt path without a blob URL (mirroring docs/STABILITY.md:4) alongside the existing https://crates.io/crates/scm-sdk/0.2.4 link, or repoint it to a commit that actually contains docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json on the published mirror once that commit exists, and record the chosen commit in docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json so a future release update can re-verify it.

nonblocking_findings.description: The 0.2.4 entry says 'Refreshes the repository lockfile' (singular), while the published CHANGELOG.md:40 it summarizes says 'Refresh both the root and native-probe lockfiles', and both Cargo.lock:1122,1772 and contracts/native-probes/Cargo.lock:1122,1771 carry the patched versions. docs/SECURITY.md:79 and docs-site/docs/developer/security.md:81 likewise say 'The 0.2.4 source lockfile'. The understatement is the same imprecision that was already corrected once in the changelog (see docs/reviews/phase-28-attempt-02.json:34).
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Say 'Refreshes the root and native-probe lockfiles to rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.10' on docs-site/docs/about/release-notes.md:28, and align the wording in docs/SECURITY.md:79 and docs-site/docs/developer/security.md:81 so the repository guide and its derived page both match CHANGELOG.md:40.

nonblocking_findings.description: verify_release_delivery() returns only guard, governanceGuard, evidenceSha256 and the SDK phase fields, so the resolved primary release checkout used for the guard is never recorded. docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/attempt-03.checks.json:71-176 consequently identifies the qualified root (/home/cdot/development/cdot65/scm-sdk-rs-ts035, via governanceGuard.qualifiedReleaseRoot and canonicalGuard.cwd) but not the governance checkout that the merged phase/evidence bytes were compared against, which is the very identity the prompt requires a reviewer to confirm. A later reader cannot tell which of several sibling worktrees produced the proof.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Add the resolved paths to the returned record, e.g. 'releaseRepo': str(release_repo) and 'qualifiedReleaseRepo': str(qualified_release_repo.resolve()) if qualified_release_repo else None, and extend docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py's governance case to assert both appear in the result.

nonblocking_findings.description: render_prompt() always evaluates prior_review_name(attempt - 1), so attempt 1 computes the stem 'attempt-00' and probes SCOPE/'attempt-00.failed.json'. It is harmless today only because the paragraph filter at line 96 drops every paragraph containing the literal '{prior}' token before substitution, so the follow-up paragraph that also holds '{prior_review}' is removed first. That coupling is implicit: if the template paragraph were ever reworded to use only {prior_review}, attempt 1 would silently render 'attempt-00.json' into the prompt, and the existing assertNotIn('attempt-00', first) guard in docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py:51 would then fail rather than prevent the defect.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Compute and apply the prior substitutions only when attempt > 1 (for example build the replacement pairs in a dict and skip the '{prior_review}'/'{prior}' entries for attempt 1), and add a test asserting that render_prompt(1) performs no prior-attempt filesystem probe.

nonblocking_findings.description: After the attempt-01 correction repointed the DEPENDENCIES.md and RELEASE.md permalinks on this page to 6f18529a (lines 7 and 73), two sibling permalinks remain pinned to the pre-0.2.4 content commit efe9de04d9f60d48e6ba8528d1a07e86376d706d without any label marking them historical: the 0.1.0 publication receipt (line 70) and the private-material scan receipt (line 95). Line 95 is the more confusing of the two because lines 144-146 of the same page tell the reader that release qualification refreshes the private scan at the clean candidate commit, so the linked phase-08 receipt is not the current one. The attempt-01 required fix explicitly asked for deliberately historical links to be kept pinned and labelled.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Label the efe9de04 permalinks on docs-site/docs/developer/security.md:70 and :95 as historical snapshots (for example 'the historical 0.1.0 publication receipt' and 'the retained phase-08 scan receipt'), or repoint them to 6f18529a where the current files live, and mirror whichever wording is chosen in docs/SECURITY.md so the authoritative guide and derived page agree.
